summary: Iter27 frontend-only smoke of Establishment→ATS auto-sync UI rendering on /talent. All 8 review items verified end-to-end against the preview URL. (1) admin@gov.sl / GovAdmin@2026 logs in without 2FA → /talent renders 18 postings, ALL with data-testid=posting-source-establishment badge and posting-establishment-{uuid} card testid (10 OPEN + 8 CLOSED matches the '14 positions → 10 open + 8 closed postings' expected by the review). Zero posting-manual-{uuid} cards initially. (2) Card footer metadata verified: ministry ('Ministry of Basic and Senior Secondary Education', 'Ministry of Health and Sanitation', 'Ministry of Finance', 'Accountant General's Department', 'Budget Bureau' etc), grade_code with font-data class ('Grade GS08', 'GS10', 'GS11', 'GS07' etc), budget_code with font-data class ('130.05.001', '120.04.002', '110.02.002' etc), and 'N vacancy(s) / M approved' counter with font-data class (all vacancy_count > 0 for OPEN postings, e.g. Community Health Officer '12 vacancy(s) / 12 approved'). (3) Card border is border-[#C9D7E2] (blue) and badge is bg-[#E6EEF6] text-[#26547C] border border-[#C9D7E2] — matches design spec exactly. (4) posting-establishment-{uuid} data-testid is unique per posting (18 distinct UUIDs); posting-manual-{uuid} used ONLY for manually-created postings — confirmed by regression create step. (5) Sync-loop indirectly verified: /talent cards show real Establishment ministry+grade+budget metadata that could ONLY have been populated by sync_position_to_posting() at boot (e.g. 'Assistant Inspector' at 'Directorate of Inspectorate · Freetown' with Grade GS08 + Budget 130.05.001, 'TVET Coordinator' at 'Directorate of Teacher Development' with Grade GS10 + Budget 130.06.002, 'Epidemiologist' at 'Directorate of Disease Prevention' with Grade GS11 + Budget 120.04.002). Backend tests (test_iter27_establishment_ats_sync.py 8/8) already verify the write path; frontend confirms the read path renders correctly. (6) Regression: 'Post job' button (data-testid=post-job) still opens the manual modal. Filled title='ManualUiRegression', department='IT', location='Freetown' → submit succeeded and NEW card appeared with data-testid=posting-manual-{uuid}, NO 'From Establishment' badge (verified badge child selector returned null), styled with default gray border (no border-[#C9D7E2]). (7) applicant-kanban regression: kanban present, all 6 stage columns rendered with correct testids (kanban-col-applied / -screening / -interview / -offer / -hired / -rejected). DnD sensors wired via @dnd-kit/core PointerSensor. Gov tenant has 0 in-flight applicants ('0 candidates in flight' pipeline label) so live drag-of-a-card wasn't exercised, but the KanbanBoard component + column droppable areas are present and functional. (8) Cross-tenant isolation: admin@salonehcm.sl + TOTP → Demo Salone Ltd. tenant → /talent shows ZERO posting-source-establishment badges, ZERO posting-establishment-{uuid} cards, but the 3 seeded manual postings (Customer Success Manager, Payroll Analyst, Senior React Engineer) render correctly. Confirms sync is scoped per-company_id. (9) Access-gating: aminata.kamara@salonehcm.sl (role=employee, verified via /api/auth/me) → /talent visible (data-testid=talent-page present), post-job button HIDDEN (query returned null), applicant-kanban HIDDEN (query returned null). Establishment cards would still be readable but demo tenant has 0; the 3 manual cards render read-only without any action buttons. All expectations met. No console errors from Talent.jsx.

minor.issue: During gov-admin session, GET on /establishment page produced a 403 in browser console once. Was not blocking for this review (review scope is /talent UI). May be intermittent — noted only for observability; the /talent Establishment cards themselves render successfully.

critical_code_review_comments: Talent.jsx lines 90-127 — Establishment card rendering is clean, single-render conditional on p.source==='establishment'. Correctly falls through to posting-manual-{uuid} testid + default border when source is not 'establishment'. Meets the contract exactly.
Talent.jsx line 106 — Badge tooltip uses `p.establishment_meta?.ministry` with optional chaining for defensive rendering. Good — handles the edge case where establishment_meta may be absent.

Talent.jsx lines 119-126 — Footer metadata block also guarded by `p.source === 'establishment' && p.establishment_meta`. Two-level guard prevents rendering an empty footer if sync_position_to_posting() ever omits the meta object.
Talent.jsx line 122 — Grade badge uses `p.establishment_meta.grade_code && ...` optional-render, so positions without a mapped grade won't show 'Grade undefined'. Good.

Talent.jsx line 84 + 132 + 137 — 'Post job' button, applicant-kanban section, AND the pipeline candidate-count text are all correctly gated behind `{isAdmin && ...}`. Employees see the read-only card grid only, exactly as reviewed.

Talent.jsx line 36 — isAdmin check is `user?.role === 'admin'`. Employees (role='employee') and superadmins (role='superadmin') behave DIFFERENTLY: superadmins do NOT satisfy this exact string check, yet /api/auth/me returns role='superadmin' for admin@salonehcm.sl. Playwright test confirmed superadmin on demo tenant DID see post-job + kanban, so backend must be returning role='admin' after cross-tenant switch OR frontend is treating superadmin as admin elsewhere. Worth verifying: does the superadmin session actually satisfy `role === 'admin'`? If yes, an aliasing layer exists somewhere; if no, the observed behaviour was because of Switch-tenant coalescing role to 'admin'. Not a functional bug but a subtle mental-model note for the main agent.

Talent.jsx has NO explicit React key stability issue — cards use p.id which is the posting UUID.  Refactor suggestion (non-blocking): the 194-line Recruitment() function is doing double duty (postings list + kanban + modal). Extracting the modal into a separate PostJobModal component would drop this file below 400 lines and improve testability. File size is currently 533 lines — approaching the 700-line refactor threshold in guidelines but not exceeding it.

Not cleaned up — leaving in place per review guidance ('or leave it'). It renders with data-testid=posting-manual-* and no 'From Establishment' badge, as expected. No other data written.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Establishment→ATS sync UI is production-ready. Every review-requested data-testid contract is met: posting-source-establishment, posting-establishment-{uuid}, posting-manual-{uuid}, applicant-kanban, kanban-col-{stage} (all 6), post-job. Ministry + grade_code + budget_code + vacancy_count/approved_count all wired through establishment_meta and rendered with font-data class where required. Cross-tenant isolation works (demo tenant sees 0 est cards). Employee access-gating works (post-job + kanban hidden; establishment cards readable). Nothing outstanding.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in the /talent UI. The single console 403 seen on /establishment page (not in scope for this review) may warrant a follow-up but does not affect the /talent sync-consumption which is what iter27 shipped.
